brief: Variaciones del alfajor original indicado por el usuario: dos tapas claras sin cobertura y relleno visible.

assets.label: Arequipe original
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: photorealistic transparent product cutout for the Lauren alfajor website.
Input image 1 is the authoritative reference for the actual product. The finished alfajor MUST look like this reference: exactly two round pale golden vanilla shortbread biscuits, gently porous handmade edges, smooth matte uncoated tops, with a generous exposed filling forming a thick smooth band between them.
Composition: one complete unbitten alfajor only, floating at the same three-quarter camera angle and gentle clockwise tilt as the reference, the upper biscuit's top visible and the lower biscuit visible in front. Center the product, filling approximately 80% of the image width. Landscape 3:2 canvas, entire product inside the frame with comfortable transparent margins.
Lighting: soft warm studio light, realistic fine crumb texture, appetizing but natural food photography, same material and proportions as the reference.
Background: actual transparent alpha channel. Remove the beige room, tabletop and linen; no floor, no cast ground shadow, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: preserve the two pale biscuit shells and their thickness, round shape, camera perspective, handmade texture and relative filling thickness. No coating, no icing, no chocolate shell, no dipped biscuit, no top decoration, no garnish, no props, no text, no logos, no watermark, no slice, no cutaway, no bite, no additional alfajores.
Primary request: recreate the reference alfajor itself as an isolated transparent cutout. Filling stays glossy rich golden caramel dulce de leche / arequipe, a generous smooth band exactly like the reference. Keep the familiar original product.
